items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: It’s an Elvis Presley song, it’s an old Gospel, but I can’t sing it

ctx.x: Well you can not do anything else. You can only do what comes out of your need, what comes out of your personal expression. You cannot do anything else. I was often thinking that I should write a rock & roll song. You know, so we’d make a little bit of more money or something. Forget it. You have to be like that. In Europe I worked in so many clubs before I met Karl. And I worked in a very famous French club with a German jazz group. We went to a lot of jazz festivals. And there was a guy that came every day…
I suppose you should have been happy that you didn’t do a good job with it because he would have come back and asked you again.
